shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'README*' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig*' -g 'public/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY' p='src/App.tsx' s=open(p).read().replace('}{editing&&','}{editing&&') open(p,'w').write(s) PY npm run build npm ls @playwright/test playwright --depth=0"
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY' p='src/App.tsx' s=open(p).read().replace('}{editing&&','}{editing&&') open(p,'w').write(s) PY npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules | head -30 && which chromium || which chromium-browser || which google-chrome'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --no-save @playwright/test && npx playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
import fs from 'node:fs';const p='src/App.tsx';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(\"const cell=(rect.width+20)/12;\", \"const gridStyle=getComputedStyle(gridRef.current"'!);const gap=parseFloat(gridStyle.columnGap);const cell=(rect.width+gap)/12;const rowHeight=parseFloat(gridStyle.gridTemplateRows)+parseFloat(gridStyle.rowGap);");s=s.replace('"'Math.round((ev.clientY-sy)/68)','Math.round((ev.clientY-sy)/rowHeight)');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);
JS
cat index.html
 git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
import fs from 'node:fs';let s=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8').replace('lang=\"en\"','lang=\"ru\"').replace('<title>Gravity UI eval</title>','<meta name=\"theme-color\" content=\"#8b62dc\" />\\n    <meta name=\"description\" content=\"Orbit — ваше персональное пространство с аналитикой, задачами и заметками. Расставляйте виджеты по-своему.\" />\\n    <title>orbit. — Мой дашборд</title>');fs.writeFileSync('index.html',s);
JS
npx --yes prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css index.html"
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && rg -n 'startDrag|rowHeight|moveWidget|filtered =|metric-comparison|function controls' src/App.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '340,530p' src/App.tsx && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apt-get; command -v dpkg-deb; command -v ldd; ls /usr/lib; cat /etc/os-release'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/orbit-browser-deps
cd /tmp/orbit-browser-deps
apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnss3 libnspr4 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libdrm2 libdbus-1-3 libxkbcommon0 libx11-6 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxext6 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 libxcb1 libxau6 libxdmcp6 libexpat1 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libharfbuzz0b libpangoft2-1.0-0 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libxrender1 libgraphite2-3 libthai0 libdatrie1 libpng16-16 libbrotli1
for package in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" extracted; done'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'data-widget-id|<section|key=\\{w.id' src/App.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-browser-deps/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-browser-deps/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/orbit-browser-deps
apt-get download libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3 libwayland-server0 libfribidi0 libxi6
for package in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" extracted; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/orbit-browser-deps
apt-get download fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core
for package in fontconfig-config*.deb fonts-dejavu-core*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" extracted; done
mkdir -p /tmp/orbit-font-cache
cat > /tmp/orbit-fonts.conf <<'"'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>
<"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd">
<fontconfig><dir>/tmp/orbit-browser-deps/extracted/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/orbit-font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/orbit-browser-deps
apt-get download libsqlite3-0
for package in libsqlite3-0*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" extracted; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx --yes prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css index.html && npm run build && git diff --stat && git status --short'
